# Security Review — pass1

## Summary
Reviewed the 23 touched files in `provenance.json` (15 client-side UI/canvas/data source files, 6 test/helper files, and 2 documentation files) against `git_head_before` (`14bb42edee3d6fee6be264e3ee78670b3b9cee79`). The change adds an optional numeric `arrowheadSize` multiplier to linear elements (`arrow` and `line`), validates imported/restored values in `packages/excalidraw/data/restore.ts` with `isFiniteNumber` and `> 0` checks (stripping non-finite, non-positive, or non-linear values), and guards against division by zero in `getArrowheadAngle` (`packages/element/src/bounds.ts`). No secrets, credentials, unsafe DOM sinks, or untrusted input vulnerabilities were introduced.

## Findings
| Severity | Category | Location | Issue | Recommendation |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| None | — | — | No security findings introduced in the touched files. | — |

- Audit log integrity: n/a — not in the touched set (no audit log tables or endpoints touched).
